author: @demo_luau_dev
text: Built my first Roblox obby in one evening with Claude writing the Luau. Prompt that worked: "Write a checkpoint system for a Roblox obby: SpawnLocation per stage, save the player's stage with DataStoreService, respawn at the last checkpoint." Paste into a Script in ServerScriptService and it just works.

author: @demo_robloxbuilds
text: 3 things I wish I knew before making my first Roblox game: 1) keep game logic in ModuleScripts in ReplicatedStorage, 2) never trust the client, validate everything on the server with RemoteEvents, 3) ship a tiny game in a weekend before your dream game. #robloxstudio #gamedev

author: @demo_indiegamecoach
text: How my Roblox game made its first $500: one gamepass (2x speed, 99 Robux), a daily reward to bring players back, and a thumbnail with a face on it. Most first games fail on the thumbnail, not the gameplay.

author: @demo_rojo_fan
text: If you code Roblox games, use Rojo + VS Code instead of the Studio script editor. Real git, real autocomplete (luau-lsp), and your AI coding agent can edit the files directly. Setup takes 10 minutes.

author: @demo_outdoorsy
text: Yosemite group camping checklist: reserve Upper Pines 5 months out on recreation.gov at 7am PT sharp, bring bear canisters (required), and assign one person per meal. Split costs in one Splitwise group from day one.

author: @demo_mealprep
text: High-protein overnight oats: oats, Greek yogurt, protein powder, chia, almond milk. Five jars, done for the week.

author: @demo_fitness
text: Zone 2 cardio is the most underrated habit: 3 x 45 minutes a week at a pace where you can still talk.
